comment: Licenses gradle/third-party-notices.gradle.kts cannot read from a POM, a package or the component itself. Each entry must match something the bundle ships, or the build fails as stale; a jars entry marked targetOnly is checked only in a bundle built for one -PtargetArch.

jj-textile.jar.name: Eclipse Mylyn WikiText Textile, repackaged by Play under jj.play
jj-textile.jar.note: Inferred from the jar's org.eclipse.mylyn.wikitext packages and its 2010 import into Play; the jar carries no license file. Source: the Eclipse Mylyn Docs project.

jj-wikitext.jar.name: Eclipse Mylyn WikiText core, repackaged by Play under jj.play
jj-wikitext.jar.note: Inferred from the jar's org.eclipse.mylyn.wikitext packages and its 2010 import into Play; the jar carries no license file. Source: the Eclipse Mylyn Docs project.

sherpa-onnx-native-lib-*.jar.name: sherpa-onnx native library, with ONNX Runtime
sherpa-onnx-native-lib-*.jar.note: The jar holds sherpa-onnx's JNI library (Apache 2.0, like sherpa-onnx itself) and ONNX Runtime 1.27.0 (MIT, https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime); its POM declares no license. Only a bundle built for one platform ships it, as the Docker image does.

com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx:sherpa-onnx.note: Its POM declares no license; the upstream repository's LICENSE is Apache 2.0.

com.grack:nanojson.note: Its POM declares no license; the upstream README says it is dual-licensed under the MIT and Apache licenses.

net.sf.oval:oval.note: Its POM declares no license; the upstream README releases all files under the Eclipse Public License 2.0. Its source code is available from that repository.

jsAlsoShipped.tailwindcss: A dev dependency, but its preflight and utility CSS are compiled into the web interface's stylesheet.

conf/browser/jev-snapshot.js.name: jev-ultrafast by Browser Use
conf/browser/jev-snapshot.js.note: JClaw's Jev browser engine carries its prompts, page scripts and this snapshot script verbatim, and ports its loop, request and executor from the Python original.
